literal: Fame-arising those-who-live-not themselves-blame-not; themselves those-who-despise blaming what?
translation: Those who do not live a life worthy of fame do not blame themselves. What is the point of them blaming those who despise them?
modern: புகழ் உண்டாகும்படி வாழாதவர்கள் தங்கள் குறையை எண்ணித் தங்களை நொந்துகொள்ள மாட்டார்கள். ஆனால், தங்களை இகழ்ந்து பேசுபவர்களை அவர்கள் நொந்துகொள்வதால் என்ன பயன்?
explanation: The couplet addresses those who fail to live a life worthy of fame. Instead of recognizing their own flaws and blaming themselves, they often get angry at others who mock them. The poet asks what purpose it serves to blame their critics. The word 'தந்நோவார்' means they will not blame themselves, highlighting their lack of self-reflection. 'நோவது' refers to the act of blaming or feeling pain, emphasizing the misdirected resentment towards their detractors.
